answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond combined with random audits. Every agent locks collateral to receive a single vote; verifiers sample agents at random, listening for a Sybil signal the way a scout tracks movement across an empty tundra. Clones that share funding or keys get slashed, forfeiting the bond, and a non-refundable opal fee is paid per registration. A thousand fake voters thus need a thousand deposits. Since audits are unpredictable, expected loss grows with the number of clones, keeping impersonation unprofitable.
